title: The DynamoDB GUI with real SQL & your AI agent
excerpt: A fast, local-first DynamoDB GUI. Real SQL with JOINs, GROUP BY and aggregates, PartiQL, and an AI agent on your own Bedrock keys. Free plan, no time limit.
content_html:
A fast, local-first desktop client for DynamoDB. Real SQL with joins and aggregations, visual editing, and an AI agent on your own Bedrock keys — everything talks straight to AWS, never through our servers.

Free 30-day trial, no credit card — then free forever on the Free plan (read-only).

Everything runs on your own AWS credentials

AWS SSOaws-vaultDynamoDB LocalBedrockPartiQLGSI / LSI

01 — AI agent

Ask your tables anything.

An agent that reads your schema, runs queries, and drafts writes — powered by Amazon Bedrock through your AWS credentials. No third-party service ever sees your data.

Your Bedrock, your keys

The model runs in your account. You pay AWS at cost, no markup, no per-seat AI tax. Prompts, schema, and rows never leave your AWS boundary.

Reads real schema

It inspects keys, GSIs and item shapes first — then picks Query over Scan when it can.

Drafts you approve

Writes are shown as a reviewable diff. Nothing is committed without your say-so.

How the AI agent works — setup, models and permissions

02 — Smart Tables

Joins for a database that has none.

Draw relationships between tables on a canvas and work the joined view live as you edit — no schema migration, no ETL.

Live recompute

Add or drop an edge and the joined grid recomputes instantly as you edit.

By PK or GSI

Join on the primary key or any global secondary index — DynoTable picks the cheapest read.

Read-only by default

The base tables are never mutated. The view is a projection you can export or query.

How Smart Tables work — the visual join canvas, in the manual

03 — SQL Workbench

Real SQL. GROUP BY, COUNT, joins.

Write a full SELECT with aggregations and multi-table joins over your live DynamoDB data — rows back in milliseconds. Real SQL, within DynamoDB's access-pattern rules.

Aggregations DynamoDB can't

SUM, AVG, COUNT DISTINCT, HAVING — the SQL you reach for, on a NoSQL store.

See the cost before you run

Every query previews its plan — Scan vs Query, the index, an RCU estimate — and reads only the rows it touches.

Drops into the grid

Results are the same data grid as everywhere else — sort, filter, and open any row.

PartiQL vs SQL — what the Workbench brings back

04 — Bring your own agent

Your favorite agent, your data.

Connect Claude Code, Cursor or Codex to DynoTable over MCP. The agent reads your schema and works your tables through a connection you scope and approve — writes still land in staging for your review.

Any MCP client

Claude Code, Cursor, Codex — connect over standard MCP with OAuth, one connection per profile.

You approve the connection

Each agent gets the scope you choose — read-only, read + stage, or full — and only the profiles you expose.

Agents propose, you commit

External agents never write directly. Changes land in staging as a reviewable diff — you commit.

Read the MCP setup guide

Why teams switch

Does what the AWS Console can't. Lighter than the cloud clients.

DynoTable vs Dynobase — the full comparison

Questions

Straight answers.

How is this different from Dynobase or the cloud clients?

Three things: a SQL Workbench that runs real joins, GROUP BY and aggregates over your tables, an AI agent that runs on your own AWS Bedrock, and a local-first design — your data and credentials never leave your machine, where cloud clients route them through their servers.

Does the AI send my data to a third party?

No. The agent runs on Amazon Bedrock through your own AWS credentials — prompts, schema, and table rows never leave your AWS account. There is no DynoTable server in the loop.

Do I have to use the AI, and what does it cost?

No. The table browser, SQL Workbench, and cost preview all work fully without it, and the AI agent is there whenever you want it. It runs on your own AWS Bedrock, so you pay AWS directly at cost — no markup, no per-seat AI tax.

Is it safe to use on my production tables?

Yes. DynoTable uses your own AWS credentials, so it can only do what your IAM policy allows — give it a read-only role and it can't change a thing. And edits never hit your tables directly: every change collects in a staging window you review before committing.

Can I use Claude Code or Cursor with my tables?

Yes. DynoTable runs a local MCP server that external agents connect to — off by default and approved per connection. The agent never writes to DynamoDB directly: every change lands in your staged commit window to review and commit, and your AWS credentials never leave your machine.

How do joins and SQL work without overloading DynamoDB?

DynoTable reads only the rows a query touches and runs the joins and aggregations on your machine — never against DynamoDB. Your tables are read with the cheapest access pattern available — Query over Scan whenever a key or index allows.

Does it work offline or with DynamoDB Local?

Yes. Point a Profile at a local endpoint (e.g. DynamoDB Local on port 8000/9000) and work entirely offline. Profiles can be online or offline, each with its own region and color.

Is DynoTable free?

The web tools — the calculators and the expression builder — are free, no sign-up. The desktop app is a free 30-day full-featured trial with no credit card required — and after the trial it stays on the Free plan, read-only (browse, query with PartiQL, export, and schema/item reads over MCP). The SQL workbench, editing, and the AI agent are per-seat, billed monthly or annually.

Do I need a credit card to start the trial?

No — the 30-day trial needs no credit card. Download DynoTable, sign in, and the full app works for 30 days. You only add a payment method if and when you decide to subscribe.

What happens when the trial ends?

Nothing is charged and you are never locked out: DynoTable stays on the Free plan (read-only) — browse, query with PartiQL, export, and keep serving schema and item reads to your agent for as long as you like, with your profiles and settings intact. Subscribing re-enables the SQL workbench, editing, and the AI agent.

Which platforms are supported?

macOS, Windows, and Linux — all available today. macOS ships as an Apple Silicon build, Windows as an x64 installer, and Linux as .deb and .rpm packages.

Stop fighting the Console.

Download DynoTable, point it at a profile, and run your first query in under a minute.

Free 30-day trial, no credit card · then free forever on the Free plan (read-only) · macOS, Windows & Linux

content_html_zh:
DynamoDB 的快速、本地优先桌面客户端。 具有连接和聚合的真正 SQL、可视化编辑以及您自己的 Bedrock 密钥上的 AI 代理 — 一切都直接与 AWS 对话，而不是通过我们的服务器。

30 天免费试用，无需信用卡 — 然后在免费计划中永久免费（只读）。

一切都在您自己的 AWS 凭证上运行

AWS SSOaws-vaultDynamoDB LocalBedrockPartiQLGSI / LSI

01 — 人工智能代理

有什么问题都可以向餐桌询问。

一个读取您的架构、运行查询和起草写入的代理 — 由 Amazon Bedrock 通过您的 AWS 凭证提供支持。 任何第三方服务都不会看到您的数据。

你的基岩，你的钥匙

该模型在您的帐户中运行。 您按成本向 AWS 支付费用，无加价，也无每台人工智能税。 提示、架构和行永远不会离开您的 AWS 边界。

读取真实模式

它首先检查键、GSI 和项目形状，然后在可能的情况下选择“查询”而不是“扫描”。

您批准的草稿

写入显示为可审查的差异。 未经您的同意，任何事情都不会发生。

AI 代理的工作原理 — 设置、模型和权限

02 — 智能桌子

连接没有数据库的数据库。

在画布上绘制表之间的关系，并在编辑时实时工作连接视图 — 无需架构迁移，无需 ETL。

实时重新计算

添加或删除边缘，连接的网格会在您编辑时立即重新计算。

通过 PK 或 GS​​I

连接主键或任何全局二级索引 — DynoTable 选择最便宜的读取。

默认只读

基表永远不会改变。 该视图是您可以导出或查询的投影。

智能表格的工作原理 - 手册中的视觉连接画布

03 — SQL 工作台

真正的SQL。 GROUP BY、COUNT、连接。

对实时 DynamoDB 数据编写包含聚合和多表联接的完整 SELECT — 在几毫秒内返回行。 DynamoDB 访问模式规则内的真正 SQL。

DynamoDB 无法聚合

SUM、AVG、COUNT DISTINCT、HAVING — 您在 NoSQL 存储上使用的 SQL。

跑步前查看费用

每个查询都会预览其计划 - 扫描与查询、索引、RCU 估计 - 并仅读取它涉及的行。

掉落到网格中

结果与其他地方相同的数据网格 - 排序、过滤和打开任何行。

PartiQL 与 SQL — Workbench 带来了什么

04 — 带上你自己的经纪人

您最喜欢的代理，您的数据。

通过 MCP 将 Claude Code、Cursor 或 Codex 连接到 DynoTable。 代理会读取您的架构并通过您范围和批准的连接来处理您的表 - 写入仍处于暂存状态以供您审核。

任何 MCP 客户端

Claude Code、Cursor、Codex — 通过标准 MCP 与 OAuth 连接，每个配置文件一个连接。

您批准连接

每个代理都会获得您选择的范围（只读、读取+阶段或完整）以及您公开的配置文件。

代理人提议，您承诺

外部代理从不直接写入。 更改作为可审查的差异出现在暂存中——您承诺。

DynoTable 与 Dynobase — 完整比较

问题

直接回答。

How is this different from Dynobase or the cloud clients?

三样东西：一个在表上运行真正连接、GROUP BY 和聚合的 SQL 工作台、一个在您自己的 AWS Bedrock 上运行的 AI 代理，以及本地优先的设计 — 您的数据和凭证永远不会离开您的机器，云客户端通过其服务器路由它们。

Does the AI send my data to a third party?

不会。代理通过您自己的 AWS 凭证在 Amazon Bedrock 上运行 — 提示、架构和表行永远不会离开您的 AWS 账户。 循环中没有 DynoTable 服务器。

Do I have to use the AI, and what does it cost?

不需要。表格浏览器、SQL Workbench 和成本预览都可以在没有它的情况下完全工作，而且只要您需要，AI 代理就在您身边。 它在您自己的 AWS Bedrock 上运行，因此您可以直接按成本向 AWS 支付 — 无加价，也无每台 AI 税。

Is it safe to use on my production tables?

是的。 DynoTable 使用您自己的 AWS 凭证，因此它只能执行您的 IAM 策略允许的操作 - 为其赋予只读角色，并且它无法更改任何内容。 并且编辑永远不会直接到达您的表：每个更改都会收集在您在提交之前查看的暂存窗口中。

Can I use Claude Code or Cursor with my tables?

是的。 DynoTable 运行外部代理连接到的本地 MCP 服务器 - 默认情况下关闭并按连接批准。 代理从不直接写入 DynamoDB：每个更改都会进入分阶段提交窗口进行审查和提交，并且您的 AWS 凭证永远不会离开您的计算机。

How do joins and SQL work without overloading DynamoDB?

DynoTable 仅读取查询涉及的行并在您的计算机上运行联接和聚合 — 绝不针对 DynamoDB。 您的表将使用最便宜的可用访问模式进行读取 - 只要键或索引允许，就通过扫描进行查询。

Does it work offline or with DynamoDB Local?

是的。 将配置文件指向本地端点（例如端口 8000/9000 上的 DynamoDB Local）并完全离线工作。 配置文件可以是在线的或离线的，每个都有自己的区域和颜色。

Is DynoTable free?

网络工具——计算器和表达式生成器——是免费的，无需注册。 该桌面应用程序是 30 天的免费全功能试用版，无需信用卡 - 试用后，它仍保留免费计划、只读（使用 PartiQL 浏览、查询、导出以及通过 MCP 读取架构/项目）。 SQL 工作台、编辑和 AI 代理按席位计费，按月或按年计费。

Do I need a credit card to start the trial?

不需要 — 30 天试用期不需要信用卡。 下载 DynoTable，登录，完整应用程序的有效期为 30 天。 仅当您决定订阅时才添加付款方式。

What happens when the trial ends?

不收取任何费用，并且您永远不会被锁定：DynoTable 保留免费计划（只读） — 使用 PartiQL 进行浏览、查询、导出，并根据您的需要为您的代理提供架构和项目读取，并且您的配置文件和设置保持不变。 订阅可重新启用 SQL 工作台、编辑和 AI 代理。

Which platforms are supported?

macOS、Windows 和 Linux — 即日起全部可用。 macOS 作为 Apple Silicon 版本发布，Windows 作为 x64 安装程序发布，Linux 作为 .deb 和 .rpm 软件包发布。

停止与控制台对抗。

下载 DynoTable，将其指向配置文件，然后在一分钟内运行您的第一个查询。
